I'm a digital marketer, social media manager and chatbot developer with 4+ years of experience and 129+ completed Fiverr orders. Most of my work is in the crypto and NFT sector — a space where trust is everything and only real community survives — alongside skincare, wellness, rental and non-profit brands. Around the social work sit Facebook ad campaigns, Mailchimp email marketing and SEO keyword research: the full toolkit, not one platform.

My approach is simple: show up every day. Consistent content in the brand's voice, genuine conversations in the niche, and design that stops the scroll. No bots, no purchased followers — growth that's slower to fake and impossible to lose overnight.

Design is a craft I take seriously: after an early lesson in how much one visual can matter, I spent three years going deep on Canva — today, content and its graphics come from the same pair of hands, so nothing waits on a designer.

Add ManyChat chatbots to the mix and the system closes the loop: content brings the audience, engagement builds the trust, and funnels capture the lead.

FAQ

Questions clients ask first

What digital marketing services do you offer?

The full set: social media management for X, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn; Facebook ads campaigns; Facebook business page setup; Instagram organic growth; Mailchimp email design and campaigns; ManyChat chatbots for Facebook pages; plus SEO and keyword research. Pick a single service or combine them into one system.

Which platforms do you manage?

X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn — one platform or all of them together. Most clients start with one channel and add more once the first is running smoothly.

How much does it cost to get started?

My Fiverr gigs start from $15 (Facebook page setup, Facebook ads setup), with Instagram marketing and email design from $25, and social media management and chatbots from $36. Monthly X management packages run $50–$180. Message me for a custom quote if your needs don't fit a gig.

Is the growth really organic?

Yes, 100%. No bots, no fake followers, no shortcuts. Real posts, real replies, real community building. It's slower than bots — but it's the only growth that survives.

Do you need my account passwords?

Not always. For Facebook and Instagram we can work through Meta Business Suite access, and scheduling tools like Buffer mean you never hand over a password. For full hands-on management, temporary access can be shared and changed any time after delivery.

What do you need from me to start?

Your brand links (website and social profiles), what you sell or promote, your target audience and brand voice, 2–3 accounts you admire, and your main goal — growth, engagement, leads or sales. Two minutes of your time, then I handle the rest.
